state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 2 (the build): the crate is on disk; nothing packs or embeds it yet.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

`extensions/image/` is the crate `nvs-image`, its own workspace and excluded from the root one (`Cargo.toml:27`). Its codec core is plain Rust on `image` 0.25 (`jpeg`, `png`, `gif`, `webp` features), tested on the host with `cargo test --lib` run from that directory. The WIT glue (`extensions/image/src/lib.rs`, module `guest`) is `cfg(target_family = "wasm")` and resolves `wit/nvs-ext` then `wit/image.wit`, the same two pushes `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs:297` makes. `simd128` is on through `extensions/image/.cargo/config.toml`, which `cargo` reads only when run from that directory. `cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip2` there builds a ~700 KB `nvs_image.wasm`, clippy-clean on both targets; `cargo deny --config ../../deny.toml check` passes. `rust-toolchain.toml` already listed `wasm32-wasip2`.

`info` is the one implemented export. Its `frames` is fixed at `1` and its `exif` at `None` (module doc of `extensions/image/src/info.rs`). Every other export returns `runtime`.

The packer is not compilable alone: `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs:33-36` reaches `manifest`, `section`, `source` and `crate::Malformed`, and `world_wit` (`pack.rs:83`) reads `world.rs`. So the goal's fallback applies to slice 2 unless the `#[path]` set stays small: a crate `crates/nvs-builtin` whose build script takes `nvs-ext` as a build-dependency. The standing decision pre-authorizes it; the commit says which was taken.

items.text: **The build script** (`rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`) — builds `extensions/image` with `--release --target wasm32-wasip2` (cwd `extensions/image`, so `.cargo/config.toml` applies) into `target/ext/`, and packs it with `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs:115` (`pack`). Decide `#[path]` versus the `crates/nvs-builtin` fallback first, from `crates/nvs-ext/src/pack.rs:33`. The image component needs an `nvsx.toml`-equivalent manifest for `Novis\Image\Codec`; the Rust template's `crates/nvs-cli/templates/ext/rust/nvsx.toml:1` is the shape.

**The built-in set and its pin** — `crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs` loads the embedded component before any `[[extension]]` entry, every load check applied, and `Novis\` is reserved for it; its digest folds into `env_hash` at `crates/nvs-config/src/cache.rs:173` (`env_hash_of`).

**The Stage 2 Rust checks** — `crates/nvs-ext/tests/builtin.rs` (four tests, the `Novis\` refusal among them), `two_builds_with_different_built_in_components_differ` beside `crates/nvs-config/src/cache.rs:173`.

backlog: `info`'s `frames` count for animated GIF, APNG and WebP, and its `exif` list (`kamadak-exif`, a standing decision) — `extensions/image/src/info.rs`.
The `extensions/image` crate has no CI leg yet: its host tests and its wasm build run only by hand — `rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`.
libwebp prebuilt by a `bun nv` tool — `rule:packaging/a-prebuilt-wasm-library-is-rebuilt-in-ci`.
`[context] modules` names nothing under `crates/nvs-ext` yet; add `pack.rs` and `builtin.rs` with `bun nv goal context --add` as slice 2 reads them.
